note: Lake McSwain Recreation Area, run by the Merced Irrigation District on the McSwain afterbay below Lake McClure, whose level stays steady all year. The lakefront sites are the lake side of the A loop; the eastern loops' shore is wooded. A 10-mph lake with a swimming beach, kayak rentals and a marina store and cafe. --Claude
summary: District McSwain page + FY2026 fee schedule + campground map + Campspot booking-site policies + Campspot API quotes (Dec, Apr, Jul) + imagery/3DEP read. $38 basic / $48 30-amp / $65 50-amp, unchanged into 2027 on Campspot; year-round, open; Campspot engine, 1-year window, same-day + walk-ins, 14-night max; 50-amp, full hookups on some sites; showers, dump, store. Lakefront KEPT: A-loop lake-side pads ~1-2 m above the steady afterbay, 14-20 m over open ground. Phone '' -> 855-800-2267; website -> the McSwain page.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakefront kept; evidence can be sharpened): the A loop's lake-side row (A7, A8, A10-A12, A14, A16 on the district map; 50-amp electric/water sites sold by the night at $65) has rigs on pads at ~37.51978,-120.30071 and ~37.51983,-120.30055, 3DEP ~122.4-123.1 m against a 121.3 m water surface, the shoreline 14-20 m south over open sandy ground with scattered shrubs (Esri zoom 19). The afterbay is held at a steady level ('water levels are not affected by local water conditions'), so the full-pool question does not arise. The E-loop shore is under continuous canopy (view at best). Suggested evidence: 'A-loop lake-side sites (A7, A8, A10-A12, A14, A16; district map): pads ~1-2 m above the steady afterbay (3DEP 122.4-123.1 m vs 121.3 m), 14-20 m over open sandy ground to the shore (Esri z19 at 37.5198,-120.3007). Read 2026-11-27.'

PIN (small, ~130 m): stored 37.51900,-120.30000 is in the water about 80 m off the A loop. Suggest 37.5200,-120.3008 (A-loop centre). Campspot's park record gives 37.519931,-120.303582 (by the day-use parking, ~330 m west), which is not better.

FEES: the fee schedule page is labelled Fiscal Year 2026 (4/1/2025-3/31/2026), now past, but Campspot's quotes for December 2026, April 2027 and July 2027 still price the sites at $38/$48/$65 plus the booking fee, so the rates stand. Second vehicle: booking-site policy $15/night vs fee schedule $12; stored $15 from the newer booking policy, with both in the fee note.
